name.zh: 黑乃与史黛菈讨论收尾
name.en: Kurono Advises Stella on the Scandal

periods.summary: Kurono tells Stella that Ikki's matches will continue under Hagun supervision and that the scandal can be resolved when Stella's father visits. She advises Stella to support Ikki as a partner when facing parents.
periods.cause: Stella worries Ikki will be forfeited or permanently trapped by the Ethics Committee.
periods.process: Kurono promises to protect Ikki's match rights, explains that the royal father's direct judgment will undercut the Ethics Committee's manufactured claims, and notes that meeting a partner's parents is a burden for both lovers.
periods.outcome: Stella decides she must fight in her own way and keep her promise with Ikki.
periods.significance: Sets the initial plan to survive until the Vermillion king's arrival and reinforces Stella's active role.
